resolution.note: post-session throws (git, ship) release the claim; a rerun by the same actor resumes its live claim or ships a commit an earlier run delivered without a new session

title: A failed lane ship releases its claim and a rerun resumes the same lane
body:
Why: logic audit: src/cli/lane-run.ts:472 an exception from steps.ship (red Check, timeout, push failure, missing origin/main at :440) skips stop(), the claim stays live, and a rerun's claimTask (:351 reclaimLane) refuses even the same actor.
Outcome: every failure path after claim releases it or a rerun by the same actor and slug reclaims it.
Proof: tests for ship throw and missing origin/main: claim released or reclaimed, rerun proceeds.
Scope: src/cli/, src/task/, test/.
